question: Cəlal Hacıyev was an employee for whom from 1909 to 1925?
context: Cəlal Hacıyev ( 2 February 1881 – 22 March 1953 ) was an Azerbaijani physicist . He is best known for his works on the theory of relativity and seismology . Hacıyev studied Mathematics and Astronomy at the Baku Mathematical Institute in 1899 , and attended lectures by Bəşir Kazımov . In this time of study , he had a friendship with his colleagues Emin Rəsulov , Həsən Səfərov and Mikayıl Qasımov . In 1900 he went to the Ganja Scientific College and achieved his Doctorate in 1902 under Nüsrət Rzayev . Afterwards , he went to the Shaki Institute of Applied Sciences , where he habilitated under Süleyman Kərimov . In 1904 he became Lecturer for Astronomy and Mathematics there , and in 1907 Associate Professor In 1908 he became Associate Professor in Baku , and in 1909 at the Shamakhi Scientific Institute . From 1925 ( until becoming Emeritus in 1947 ) he again was in Shaki as the successor of Vəli Həmidov on the chair of applied mathematics . One of his students was Yalçın Quliyev .

question: What was the name of the employer Fərid Şahbazov work for from 1993 to 1997?
context: Fərid Şahbazov ( born 10 January 1964 ) is an Azerbaijani scientist , composer and director of the Caspian Music Technology Research Lab . Before joining Caspian Music Technologies he led Khazar Computing Laboratory in Baku . He is one of the pioneers of computer music closely linked to artificial intelligence , especially in the field of machine improvisation and style modelling . He has been elected Caspian Association for Artificial Intelligence Fellow in 2014 . In 1993 , he was appointed Assistant Professor ( locally , Assistant Professor ) , at Baku Computing Institute until 1997 in Computer Science , Research and Teaching . In 1997 , Şahbazov moved to Khazar Computing Laboratory ( Computer Science Laboratory ) Baku . He started a research activity on music and artificial intelligence . His team has authored and pioneered many technologies ( about 35 patents ) about electronic music distribution , audio feature extraction and music interaction . He was appointed director of Khazar Computing Laboratories in 2014 . The KCL ( the branch of Khazar Computing Laboratory Ganja ) is dedicated to basic research in computer science ; it was created by Cavid Kazımov and Fuad Rəsulov in 1996 . Since 2017 , he is director of Caspian Music Technology Research Lab in Baku , where he develops tools for assisting music creation .

question: What was the name of the employer Səlim İbrahimov work for from 1968 to 1996?
context: Səlim İbrahimov ( 4 February 1947 – 16 November 2019 ) was an Azerbaijani astronomer who worked primarily in solar physics . He held the posts of Chief Astronomer of the Regional Observatory , the Senior Professor of Astronomy at the Shamakhi Astronomy Institute , and honorary professorships at both the Baku Institute of Physical Sciences and the Ganja Astronomy College . The Shamakhi Astronomy Institute employed him as an astronomy research assistant in 1968–70 and lecturer from 1970 , while he was still studying for his PhD . In 1978 he was promoted to senior lecturer , and then reader in 1980 . He received a research fellowship from the Ulduz Research Foundation in 1983–1984 . He was then promoted to chair of astrophysics from 1984 and became the Senior Professor of Astronomy in 1996 . Beginning in 1986 , he was head of Shamakhi Institutes astronomy & astrophysics research group İbrahimov received additional appointments as honorary professor at the Baku Institute of Physical Sciences from 1996 , and the Ganja Astronomy College from 1998 . He taught astronomy at all university levels , from first year undergraduate to postgraduate courses .

question: What was the name of the employer Rəşid Əfəndiyev work for from 1984 to 1985?
context: Rəşid Əfəndiyev is an Azerbaijani international law scholar and human rights practitioner . He is Senior Professor of Law at Ganja Legal Studies Institute , and co-Chair of the law schools Center for Human Rights and Global Justice . question: Cavid Həsənli became a member of what organization or association in 1964?
context: Cahangir Həsənov ( born 22 March 1946 ) , better known as his stage name Cavid Həsənli , is an Azerbaijani musician , songwriter and record producer . He is best known as lead guitarist of the 1960s Azerbaijani rock band the Səhər Sədaları who with fellow member Rauf Nəcəfov formed the 1970s and 1980s songwriting and record production duo Həsənli & Nəcəfov . Həsənlis family migrated to Baku from Shaki in 1963 , and settled in Baku . Həsənli , who had been a guitarist with the Shaki-based band the Ulduzlar , came to fame in 1964–65 as the lead guitarist of the Səhər Sədaları . In the same year he met rhythm guitarist Rauf Nəcəfov at the Baku newcomers hostel . In 2007 , Caspian Musician magazine selected this meeting as the most significant event in Azerbaijani pop and rock music history .

question: Which award did Mənsur Kazımov receive in 1871?
context: Dr . Mənsur Kazımov ( 26 June 1836 – 1 March 1903 ) was an Azerbaijani historian and museum director . In March 1871 , the Regional Cultural Council honoured him with the Cultural Heritage Medal . In 1875 , the Senate of the Shaki Historical Studies College promoted him as Doctor Honoris causa in Literature . In 1882 , he was appointed as a member of the Caspian Society of Arts and Sciences . On 31 August 1898 , he was decorated with the Order of Service to Culture . He was a member of several national and international societies As one of the leading specialists in hieratic of his time , a portrait bust of Mənsur Kazımov was included in the funerary monument for Həmid Qasımov in the garden of the Historical Museum in Baku .

question: Nigar Səlimova went to which school from 1891 to 1894?
context: Nigar Səlimova ( 1872–1917 ) was an educator in Azerbaijan , responsible for the founding of schools , becoming the first Principal of Shamakhi Womens College , Shamakhi , Azerbaijan and then Principal of Caspian Womens College , Shaki , Azerbaijan from 1913 until her death in 1917 . She was born on 4 September 1872 in Sabunchu , Baku , the eldest sister of Cavid Səlimov , who became vice-principal of the Ganja Higher Education Institute . Her father , Səlim Səlimov , was an Azerbaijani merchant , and her mother was , Zəhra Səlimova , née Quliyeva . She was educated at Shamakhi Girls School and attended Caspian Teacher Training College , Baku from 1891 until 1894 , where she obtained a first class degree studying Azerbaijani and Russian . From 1895 to 1896 , she studied Oriental languages at Shaki Language College , Shaki She reputedly had a working knowledge of 14 languages . She then spent a time also teaching at Ganja Girls School .

question: Which team did Murad Hacıyev play for from 1996 to 1998?
context: Murad Hacıyev ( ; born 9 October 1975 ) is an Azerbaijani retired footballer who played as a centre forward . He captained the Azerbaijan national team to the Round of 16 at the 2006 National Football Cup which remains their best ever performance to date . His four goals in the Caspian Champions League are the most scored by any Azerbaijani player . In 1995 , Hacıyev moved to Ganja to play with Ganja Dawn ( now Ganja Unity ) . He spent three-and-a-half seasons with the club , helping it to win three doubles in Azerbaijan between 1996 and 1998 . He was also part of the Ganja Dawn team that reached the third round of the Caspian Cup in 1997 and went on to make his Caspian Champions League group stage debut with the club a year later . He won the Best Footballer Award in the Regional League in his time at Ganja .

question: Dəniz Rəhimov played for which team from 1997 to 1999?

Rəhimov played as a central defender for National Premier League club Baku Horizon and National Football League side , Lankaran Stars . Rəhimov scored a goal in their 4–1 win over eventual season championship winners Ganja South at Lankaran City Stadium on 7 December 1997 . Lankaran Stars finished 8th on the table at the end of the season . Rəhimov was awarded the prestigious Lankaran Stars Most Glorious Player award . The following season proved to be more successful for Lankaran Stars finishing 3rd after losing the preliminary final to Baku Unity at Baku on 23 May 1999 . Rəhimov was awarded again the prestigious Lankaran Stars Most Glorious Player award this time jointly with Sərxan Hacıyev .
